name: bettersearch
title: BetterSearch
description: Typo-tolerant file name and file content search for Vicinae, powered by the fff engine, with frecency ranking, git status, live previews and a file watcher.
author: selfxplanatorium

commands.name: search-files
commands.title: Search Files
commands.subtitle: BetterSearch
commands.description: Fuzzy search file and folder names across your indexed directories.

commands.name: search-file-contents
commands.title: Search File Contents
commands.subtitle: BetterSearch
commands.description: Search inside text files with plain, regex or fuzzy matching.

commands.name: manage-index
commands.title: Manage File Index
commands.subtitle: BetterSearch
commands.description: Show index status, rescan directories or restart the fff background index.

preferences.name: roots
preferences.title: Indexed Directories
preferences.description: Comma-separated directories to index. Hidden folders are skipped outside git repositories; .gitignore rules are respected inside them.

preferences.name: editorCommand
preferences.title: Editor Command
preferences.description: Command used to open a file at a line. Placeholders: {file}, {line}, {column}. Leave empty to use the default application.

preferences.name: editorInTerminal
preferences.label: Run editor command in a terminal (for nvim, helix, micro...)
preferences.description: Launch the editor command inside your default terminal emulator.

preferences.name: showPreview
preferences.title: Display
preferences.label: Show preview panel
preferences.description: Show a preview of the selected file or match next to the results.

preferences.name: followSymlinks
preferences.label: Follow symlinked directories
preferences.description: Index the contents of symlinked directories.
